spans.s: AT0189 लेपः lepaḥ This is a method of treatment in which medicines are used topically in the form of paste or ointment.
BK0089 लेपः lepaḥ a semi-solid medicament used for external application
SK0114 लेपः lepaḥ 1. Smearing, anointing, to spread over a surface. 2. The function of Māṃsa Dhātu, i.e., to provide covering/ coating to the skeleton.
AF1120 लेप मुखस्य lepa mukhasya Coating in the mouth
SV0143 लेपन lepana Anointing/application- here application of antiseptics, any other germicidal solution to vitiated land to maintain biologically hygiene.
